fact: The General Information Authority and the Central Bank of Libya reviewed linking the Level 3 biometric digital identity to banking systems for eKYC, and technical trials with the Central Bank and a number of banks had already begun as a prelude to launch and integration (the document gives no trial date, so its published date is used).
system: Digital Identity Management System for Citizens (Level 3)

fact: The NESDB executive summary says the General Information Authority is the body authorized to implement the digital identity project, with NESDB supervising, to issue and verify a digital ID wallet for each citizen; it presents a proposed framework and roadmap, not a service in use.
system: Libya digital identity project (digital identity wallet)
